trial_title: Everolimus in Treating Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Thyroid Cancer
brief_summary:
RATIONALE: Everolimus may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth and by blocking blood flow to the tumor.

PURPOSE: This phase II trial is studying how well everolimus works in treating patients with locally advanced or metastatic thyroid cancer.

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically confirmed thyroid cancer
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of locally advanced or metastatic thyroid cancer?

eligibility_table.criterion: Progressive or refractory disease within the past 6 months
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has anaplastic astrocytoma of the spine, which is progressive and refractory given the history of multiple treatments.

eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
